channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Burglars steal service pistol, 30 live cartridges, jewellery and cash from Nanded head constable’s home
item.description: A case was registered at Nanded Rural Police Station on September 19, 2026, under Sections 331(4) and 305 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita

item.title: BJP wins six of seven mayoral polls in Rajasthan; Congress cries foul
item.description: The BJP defeated the Congress in Alwar, Udaipur, Pali and Ajmer, while its candidates were elected unopposed in Bharatpur and Bhilwara; the only consolation for Congress came in Bikaner

item.title: Academicians write to Governor opposing the inter-university transfer of teachers
Mahayuti Minister Mangal Prabhat Lodha is suppressing voice of community members, alleges Jain Monk
item.description: ‘I spoke to State Assembly Speaker Rahul Narvekar and told him if the issue is not resolved, I will stage protest outside the Godiji Parshvanath Jain temple in Mumbai’s Paydhuni,’ said Muni Nileshchandra

item.title: Court orders fresh hearing in Sonia Gandhi’s voter roll entry case
item.description: Special Judge Vishal Gogne said that a Magisterial Court, instead of considering the core aspect of whether the complaint disclosed commission of a cognisable offence, digressed towards the issue of citizenship

item.title: Class 10 girl and boy returning from coaching groped and assaulted in Bihar’s Jamui, sparking a political row
item.description: Police register suo motu FIR, arrest three as viral video of crime sparks political row; NCW directs support for teens, says steps should be taken to stop video circulation; Rahul Gandhi slams patriarchy; Tejashwi says Bihar put to shame by NDA govt.

item.title: SBSP chief Rajbhar’s claim on U.P. division ignites fresh debate as opposition hit out at NDA
item.description: ‘Once the caste census is completed, there will be no problem in carrying out the division; we will divide the State after the caste census; this is what the Prime Minister of the country said,’ Om Prakash Rajbhar says

item.title: Union Minister Shivraj Chouhan accuses Punjab government of sheltering drug peddlers
item.description: Today, Punjab has got the ‘MOD Model’ — Model of Drug Development; the AAP is running a government of crime, corruption and commission in Punjab, said Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan

item.title: Plea in M.P. High Court seeks closure of Ladli Behna scheme over its financial cost; notice issued to government
item.description: ₹1,500 is not enough to run a household, and there is no study to show that it is helping women create long-term financial opportunities, said Sudha Dubey

item.title: Party-backed councillors detained in Haryana ahead of Rajasthan local body poll, alleges Congress
item.description: The councillors were returning from Himachal Pradesh, where the party had moved them in a bid to prevent defections ahead of the election

item.title: 100% drought likely to be declared in Maharashtra by month-end, says Minister
item.description: Never seen such severe dry spell: Cooperation Minister Babasaheb Patil; he adds govt. has initiated measures such as fee waiver for students, electricity bill waiver, and deployment of water tankers

item.title: J&K House Committee finds ‘irregularities’ in Jal Jeevan Mission, calls for probe
item.description: While some progress has been achieved in certain areas as far as implementation of JJM is concerned, yet the overall objective of the Mission has remained unachieved, said NC legislator Hasnain Masoodi

item.title: BDCC bank waiting for govt. sanction for recruitment, says MLA
Belagavi students trained by zilla panchayat get into premier institutions
Supreme Court orders fresh probe into 2012 rape-murder near Dharmasthala in Karnataka
item.description: Top court directs State to constitute a tech-savvy and efficient SIT without any officer from the old probe team and complete the investigation within three months; lone accused in case was acquitted by CBI court in 2023

item.title: Ram Temple donations theft case: SIT report finds 105 instances of unauthorised currency removal
item.description: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta, appearing for Uttar Pradesh, says probe has been “substantially concluded” and a charge sheet will be filed before the court of Additional Sessions Judge on or before September 25, 2026

item.title: New checklist by Keralam research team records 3,261 flowering plant species in Agasthyamalai Biosphere Reserve
item.description: Compilation by team from Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden and Research Institute seeks to reaffirm global significance of Western Ghats as a biodiversity hotspot and need for focused, region-specific strategies for protecting it

item.title: Karnataka to track cancer patients after fake drug bust
item.description: In order to make it easy for laboratories, doctors, and pharmaceutical firms to differentiate between fake and original drugs, the department has written to the headquarters of Pfizer to release their reference standards, says Health Minister U.T. Khader

item.title: ASR Collector reviews ‘Trishul’ strategy against crime in district
Six arrested within 24 hours for ₹40-lakh Kalyan robbery; cash, motorcycles worth ₹36.48 lakh recovered
item.description: The Crime Branch traced the accused through technical analysis and informants and recovered cash and two motorcycles together valued at ₹36.48 lakh

item.title: Assembly witnesses blame game on origin of Kasturirangan report
G. Palanithurai appointed Adviser to Minister Anand
Getting away from gunshots
item.description: For many young Israelis, Dharamkot in Himachal Pradesh offers an escape from the pressures of military service and conflict, drawing them to India’s Hummus Trail, in search of peace and healing. Though there has been a marginal dip in visitors after the war, locals in the tranquil Himalayan retreat worry about over tourism, drug use, and rave culture, finds Vikas Vasudeva

item.title: It may be time for Thirumavalavan to lead alliance in 2031: VCK general secretary
Tamil Nadu bypolls: After DMK’s plaint to EC, TVK drops leaders of alliance parties from star campaigner list
item.description: The TVK has named leaders of its alliance partners in its list of star campaigners for the Madurantakam and Dharapuram bypolls

item.title: Assistant professor recruitment candidates demand independent panel for re-evaluating papers
item.description: They demand that the panel contain subject matter experts who have experience in assessment and pedagogy to re-evaluate the answer papers, in addition to a statistician

item.title: Tamil Nadu explains to Cauvery Authority the rationale behind its demand for clearing backlog of 16 tmc ft
item.description: It says the demand is based on the principle of pro-rata share in the flows realised. The Cauvery tribunal and the SC had referred to the concept of pro-rata for adoption in times of distress

item.title: Hyderabad’s Paradise-Shamirpet elevated corridor hopes to take long-distance traffic off local roads
item.description: The 18.18-km corridor is planned to have multiple entry and exit ramps,, allowing motorists to bypass several busy junctions, while the existing road below will continue to serve local traffic. The project is estimated to be completed by the beginning of 2028.

item.title: businessline’s 8th Changemaker Awards to be presented by Finance Minister
Collector inspects dengue prevention measures in Cuddalore
item.description: Residents were advised to remove unwanted objects in which rainwater could collect, prevent water stagnation in household articles, and clean overhead water tanks at least once a week

item.title: SIT files chargesheet in Sai Krishna’s alleged custodial death case
NTR Collector launches ‘Operation Trishul’ to combat drug usage, crimes against women and road accidents
item.description: Launching the programme, G. Lakshmisha says officials of the Medical and Health, Police, Women Development and Child Welfare and other departments will take measures to check crimes under Operation Trishul

item.title: Visakhapatnam tops YouthPOWER rankings in A.P. handbook
Centre plans to reward safe drivers with low insurance premiums
item.description: Union Road Transport Minister Nitin Gadkari had earlier said that the government was planning a negative points system to make drivers more accountable and improve road safety across the country.

item.title: ‘Partners for Multilateralism’: India to attend new non-superpower grouping’s inaugural session at UN
item.description: Leaders of the EU, Brazil, Canada and Kenya launched a forum with a joint call for UN reform, collective action amidst conflicts

item.title: DBRC held livelihood support programme for waste and hair pickers in Vijayawada
Cultural performances mark Mahakavi Gurajada’s 164th birth anniversary in Vijayawada
Three Bandlaguda RTO officials suspended after viral video shows cash being counted
Supreme Court issues notice on plea in sinking of MSC Elsa 3
item.description: A Bench headed by Justice K.V. Viswanathan sought a response from Elsa 3 Maritime Inc., the company that owned the vessel

item.title: A.P. Health Minister orders action against doctors and staff for remaining absent from duties
Stella Maris, Officers IAS Academy launch civil services coaching programme
Anitha warns of action against YSRCP activists who tried to attack Physical Education Teachers
Orange, red alerts for A.P. as depression in Bay is likely to bring heavy rain in next three days
item.description: Heavy to very heavy rainfall is expected at a few places in Srikakulam, Parvathipuram Manyam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, ASR, Anakapalli, Kakinada, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema, East Godavari, West Godavari, Krishna and Eluru districts

item.title: With shortage in hydel and wind energy, KPCL to ramp up thermal power from January
item.description: Recently, KPCL managing director Rajendra Cholan met officials from the Ministry of Coal in New Delhi to discuss the coal requirement to ramp up thermal power.

item.title: Tamil Nadu government hospitals running short of critical medicines for pre-term babies
item.description: Surfactant medicines are essential to inflate the lungs of pre-term babies in need of the therapy. Inquiries with a number of hospitals and doctors reveal that a number of centres have been facing short supply of surfactant drugs

item.title: State owes sanctioned subsidies, incentives worth ₹2,880 crore to 3,716 industrial units: KASSIA
item.description: Timely resolution of MSME concerns will strengthen investor confidence and improve the ease of doing business in the State, says trade body president, Ninganna Biradar

item.title: ED files chargesheet against EaseMyTrip promoter Nishant Pitti in Mahadev betting app case
item.description: Pitti, on behalf of the promoters of NzVs Easy Trip Planners Ltd., entered into a pre-arranged stock price manipulation deal with Amardeep Sharma to artificially inflate the share price and market capitalisation of IWs Easy Trip Planners Ltd., the chargesheet filed in a special PMLA court says

item.title: Supreme Court asks Tamil Nadu government to consider alternative site rather than evicting SASTRA varsity
item.description: If someone was running a resort or a commercial complex or having a shopping mall there or having immoral or illegal activity there, we would have thrown them out, said the CJI

item.title: KPSC comes up with reforms to ensure transparency in future exams
item.description: Key reforms to be implemented include changing format of OMR sheets, uploading answer sheets to the website for public access and so on

item.title: Lathi-charge at Jurala; KTR faults govt. for denying water to Jurala ayacut
item.description: Party leaders term it govt. failure, when A.P. taking away water for its projects outside the basin

item.title: T.N. Energy Resources Minister launches State solar subsidy scheme
item.description: Consumers who have applied from August 5 would be eligible to receive the combined Central and State government subsidy of ₹35,000 for 1 kilo watt (kW), ₹70,000 for 2kW, and ₹1,00,000 for 3 kW

item.title: Opposition candidates raise allegations of intimidation during bypoll campaigning in West Bengal
item.description: Congress candidate Milan Pradhan seeks bail as his wife claims the arrest was based on fake cases; AJUP’s Humayun Kabir alleges harassment of his supporters while adding that he will ‘see’ things on polling day

item.title: KPSC veterinary officer recruitment scam: CID probe reveals money trail, question-paper leak network
Youth power will build a new India: BJP chief Nitin Nabin
item.description: The ultimate goal of the young generation should not be limited to their own or their family’s development, but should be nation building, says the BJP chief at a ‘Yuva Samvad’ in Uttar Pradesh’s Meerut town

item.title: J&K government invokes Article 311 provisions for the first time, to fire teacher accused of raping student
item.description: Teacher faces POCSO, BNS charges of raping 14-year-old who subsequently died; Article 311 provisions have been repeatedly invoked by the J&K L-G to fire State employees without enquiry, but this is the first use by the State’s elected government

item.title: Mamata faction of Trinamool unveils new symbol of football player
item.description: The new symbol is a footballer in the middle of a logo and around it, the party’s new name ‘Mamata All India Trinamool Congress’ is written in white letters on a blue background

item.title: Revanth directs officials to expedite Warangal super-speciality hospital works
Odisha puts 11 districts on high alert as low-pressure system likely to intensify
item.description: The India Meteorological Department predicts the system would move west-northwestwards and is likely to arrive near the north Andhra Pradesh and South Odisha coasts early on September 23

item.title: IIT-Bombay removes Doolla as Dean; students seek suspension as Professor
item.description: The institute's Director, Shireesh Kedare, in an official mail, said that Prof. Doolla, presently serving as Dean (Administrative Affairs), has been removed from the post, as per officials

item.title: Narayana Guru’s vision forms the core of Keralam’s social reformation: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan
item.description: The Keralam CM says that the entire credit for the State’s secular ideals goes to Sree Narayana Guru
